source_scope: Pittsburgh recording reused for tracking, excluded from SAM3 detector training/validation/36-frame regression. New complete detection annotation in a fixed temporal sample.
reference_policy: Annotate every visible on-floor player or goalie, including partial players with a distinguishable body. Exclude bench players, officials and spectators. Raw images plus existing YOLO proposals assist boxes; add missing players and correct proposal bounds by visual review. Assistant-reviewed, not independent human ground truth.
freeze_policy: Seal all annotations before inspecting SAM3 or rink-filter predictions on these frames. No retraining or selection on this audit.
methods: original SAM3 hockey-player prompt at validation-selected threshold0.6
same fine-tune plus frozen hockey-rink surface mask threshold0.3/dilation0.025
existing YOLO detections at the pipeline threshold0.1; proposal-assisted reference can favor this baseline
evaluation: Confidence-ordered one-to-one box matching at IoU0.5. Report TP/FP/FN/precision/recall/F1 and per-frame outcomes. All11frames remain regardless of outcome.
limits: One correlated interval in a reused recording, with detector-assisted reference; not independent game-level accuracy. Results cannot change frozen model/filter choices.
